Compute GLM Effect Estimate for a Single Subgroup

Source: R/grf_subg_harm_glm.R
create_glm_row.Rd

Fits a GLM within the specified subgroup and returns a one-row data frame containing the effect estimate, confidence interval, sample size, and event count. Supports binary, continuous, and count (with offset) outcomes.

Usage

create_glm_row(
  df,
  outcome.name,
  treat.name = "treat",
  effect_measure = "log_OR",
  offset.name = NULL,
  overdispersion = "none",
  conf.level = 0.95,
  min_arm_n = 5L,
  min_arm_events = 3L,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

df

Data frame for the subgroup (already subset).

outcome.name

Character. Name of the outcome column.

treat.name

Character. Name of the treatment indicator.

effect_measure

Character. Effect measure; see grf.subg.harm.glm for options.

offset.name

Character or NULL. Name of the person-time column. When supplied, log(offset) is added as an offset term. Default: NULL.

overdispersion

Character. One of "none", "quasi", "negbin". Default: "none".

conf.level

Numeric. Confidence level. Default: 0.95.

min_arm_n

Integer. Minimum observations per arm; returns NA row if either arm is below this threshold. Default: 5L.

min_arm_events

Integer. For binary/count outcomes, minimum events per arm; returns NA row if check fails. Default: 3L.

verbose

Logical. Default: FALSE.

Value

A one-row data frame with columns: N, n_treat, n_control, events_treat, events_control (for binary/count), est, lower, upper, se, effect_measure.

See also
